resource.name: sms-service
resource.description: An internal SMS sending service used to deliver text messages to end users on behalf of consuming projects.

config.description: Base URL of the SMS service API.

resource.consumptionInstructions: Whenever a project needs to send an SMS, call this service's API using the configured base URL. No authentication is required — the endpoint is reachable directly. Generate a client from the published OpenAPI contract rather than hand-writing requests.
